name: Campingplatz Stadlerhof
beschreibung: The Stadlerhof campsite is located in Kramsach in the Tiroler Unterinntal in a rural setting. The site is surrounded by meadows and forest and offers a view of the surrounding mountains. Marked hiking trails and cycling trails run through the surrounding area. The ski areas of the Alpbachtal and Wildschönau region can be reached quickly by car. The campsite has a reception and a lounge. Amenities include sanitary facilities, electricity connections and waste disposal for motorhomes. The site is open year-round and offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents.
